items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stanley Dance is always saying to me, “Why don’t you have Cliff Smalls,” and I’ve tried, but he’s always working somewhere, gone to Japan or something

ctx.x: Sort of a Daddy Dearest sort of a . . .

Yes. The funny thing is, Duke was always so revered. Nobody wanted to see anything bad written about him. I think probably Stanley Dance or somebody close got that book removed, because it . . . I’ve got it somewhere, but it . . . I read it . . .
